|strategy=By [mailto:vanfleet@bucknell.edu Jim Van Fleet]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/corporaljanse.html</ref>

You have to like a character with [[Corporal Janse]]'s numbers; deploy 2 power 2 ability 2 makes for a very versatile warrior in almost any Light deck. His forfeit 4 is better than average, and his destiny of 3 is useful too.

In [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] booster draft play, this character is a welcome addition. He has the Scout characteristic, but his real power is his sharpshooter/sniper status! Give him the [[A280 Sharpshooter Rifle]] in normal play and he makes [[Sorry About The Mess]] a Used Interrupt. He fires for free, can target a Dark character at an adjacent site, then adds 2 plus 1 to the weapon destiny draw, a very lethal combination!

Afraid to leave him alone to accomplish all this? How about setting up [[Corporal Janse]] out at the 4th marker to support your [[Echo Base Operations]] deck. He can hide just under the shields, and pick off the Imperials as they try to march in!

Combos: - sets up a weapon destiny of at least 4 before you even draw!

- During the [[Control (Coruscant){{!}}Control]] phase, no-one can hear you scream.
